f816f0f1c79747ce04a1676afb652f68d806d148: Goulier is a discreet resort of modest scale: 7 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Goulier's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Pyrenees for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The modest altitude of Goulier, from 800 m at the base to 1,550 m at the summit, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside that window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. With a day lift pass at just 15€, Goulier is one of the most affordable destinations in France. For families on a tight budget, or skiers who want to make the most of their days without breaking the bank, it's a sincere and often overlooked choice. In short: Goulier is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a genuinely family atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It's hard to have a bad stay here.

f87d38779b2e651e5b806b0462aabc9681deb17a: A human-scale resort, Glacier du Kaunertal focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 55 km of runs are ideal for a 3- to 4-day stay, especially for families or for skiers who don't need to keep changing their playground. Glacier du Kaunertal's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. As for snow, Glacier du Kaunertal is in a strong position with its highest point at 3,113 m — even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 2,150 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from mid-December onwards. The budget for a stay at Glacier du Kaunertal is clearly high: 75€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It's the price of excellence — but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Glacier du Kaunertal lives up to its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
